# Dima Mikheiev

> Dima Mikheiev is an AI Systems Architect who builds AI agents, automation systems, marketing workflows, and AI video production systems for business teams.

## Site

- [Home](https://mikheiev.com/): overview of Dima Mikheiev, services, selected work, proof points, FAQ, and contact links.

## Primary Positioning

Dima helps teams find where AI can improve business operations, then builds systems that make those improvements work in practice.

## Services

- AI Systems & Agents: AI agents connected to company data, APIs, and business tools.
- Marketing Automation: AI systems for content creation, campaign management, product data workflows, and repeat-task automation.
- AI Video & Content: workflows using AI image, video, voice, avatars, automation, and human review.
- AI Lead Generation: agents that find leads, qualify them against an ideal customer profile, write personal outreach, and save records in a CRM.

## Proof Points

- 15+ years in technology.
- $600K+ earned on Upwork.
- 200+ completed projects.
- 100% Job Success Score.
- Upwork Top Rated Plus.
- YouTube Shorts channel reached 1,000+ subscribers with $0 spent on ads.

## Selected Work

- AI System for a U.S. Wellness Brand: connected product data, brand rules, content generation, Monday.com, Notion, and Google Drive to create branded images, posters, and infographics.
- AI Video Production Systems: connected image generation, video models, AI voices, avatars, automation, and human review into repeatable production workflows.
- YouTube Shorts Automation: production workflow for creating and publishing short-form video content at scale using AI image, video, and voice models. The channel reached 1,000+ subscribers with $0 spent on ads.
- AI Lead Generation Agent: automated lead research, qualification, personalized outreach, and CRM saving.
